svg.title: Two-piece floating ball valve
svg.desc: Isometric drawing of a two-piece floating ball valve, NPS 2 (DN50) class 150, flanged, 178 mm face to face, shown open: lever and ball bore parallel to the pipe. Open view: the front half of end cap, body, ball, seats and packing is cut away on the plane of the pipe and stem axes. One 49 mm bore runs straight through end cap, PTFE seats and ball (full bore), with the flow centreline. A tang on the stem engages a slot across the ball crown, parallel to the bore, so the ball floats against the downstream seat. Three packing rings and a gland follower fill the stuffing box in the neck. Six studs clamp end cap to body; two lie in the cut plane. Gland nut, lever and lever nut are exploded up the stem axis on a dashed guide; the lever has a bent stop tab. Closed view: the assembled valve, lever seated, its tab against a stop pin on the neck collar.
